def build_agent(sandbox):
    # Define beam positions and joints
    left_beams = []
    middle_beam = None
    right_beams = []
    
    # Create left strip beams (x=12.5, in [12.4,12.6])
    for y in [1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0, 4.5, 5.0, 6.0]:
        beam = sandbox.add_beam(x=12.5, y=y, width=0.2, height=0.3, density=500.0)
        left_beams.append(beam)
    
    # Create middle strip beam (x=12.95, in [12.9,13.1])
    middle_beam = sandbox.add_beam(x=12.95, y=3.0, width=0.2, height=0.3, density=500.0)
    
    # Create right strip beams (x=13.5, in [13.4,13.6])
    for y in [1.0, 6.0]:
        beam = sandbox.add_beam(x=13.5, y=y, width=0.2, height=0.3, density=500.0)
        right_beams.append(beam)
    
    # Connect beams in left strip
    for i in range(len(left_beams) - 1):
        # Anchor point at the midpoint between beams
        anchor_y = (left_beams[i].position.y + left_beams[i+1].position.y) / 2
        joint = sandbox.add_joint(left_beams[i], left_beams[i+1], anchor_point=(12.5, anchor_y), type='rigid')
    
    # Connect left strip to middle beam
    anchor_y = (left_beams[3].position.y + middle_beam.position.y) / 2
    joint = sandbox.add_joint(left_beams[3], middle_beam, anchor_point=(12.5, anchor_y), type='rigid')
    
    # Connect middle beam to right strip
    # Lower right beam (y=1.0)
    anchor_y = (middle_beam.position.y + right_beams[0].position.y) / 2
    joint = sandbox.add_joint(middle_beam, right_beams[0], anchor_point=(13.5, anchor_y), type='rigid')
    # Upper right beam (y=6.0)
    anchor_y = (middle_beam.position.y + right_beams[1].position.y) / 2
    joint = sandbox.add_joint(middle_beam, right_beams[1], anchor_point=(13.5, anchor_y), type='rigid')
    
    # Connect beams in right strip
    for i in range(len(right_beams) - 1):
        anchor_y = (right_beams[i].position.y + right_beams[i+1].position.y) / 2
        joint = sandbox.add_joint(right_beams[i], right_beams[i+1], anchor_point=(13.5, anchor_y), type='rigid')
    
    return left_beams[0]  # Return any beam as the chassis
